detail_steps: Register at QC E-Services using a personal email (1 email per registrant)
Confirm and validate the E-Services account
variants.note: Fee and time not stated in the sources read.
variants.note_tl: Hindi nakasaad sa mga nabasang source ang bayad at tagal.
detail_steps_tl: Magparehistro sa QC E-Services gamit ang personal na email (isang email bawat nagpaparehistro)
Kumpirmahin at i-validate ang E-Services account

detail_steps: Log in and choose the QCitizen ID eApplication icon
Complete personal information and tick “Yes” for the Persons With Disability sector
Upload requirements; a virtual ID shows on submission, then agree and submit
Monitor application status in your E-Services account
variants.note: Non-apparent disability validation takes 2–3 days. Renewal of a white PWD ID is processed as a new application.
variants.note_tl: Ang validation para sa non-apparent disability ay inaabot ng 2–3 araw. Ang pag-renew ng puting PWD ID ay pinoproseso bilang bagong aplikasyon.
detail_steps_tl: Mag-log in at piliin ang QCitizen ID eApplication icon
Kumpletuhin ang personal na impormasyon at i-tick ang “Yes” para sa Persons With Disability sector
I-upload ang mga requirement; may lalabas na virtual ID pagka-submit, saka pumayag at i-submit
Bantayan ang status ng aplikasyon sa iyong E-Services account

detail_steps: Bring copies of requirements to PDAO for evaluation
Staff encode your information; it is approved and verified
Printed ID is given to you
Applicants with missing requirements are assisted and advised
detail_steps_tl: Dalhin ang mga kopya ng requirement sa PDAO para ma-evaluate
Ie-encode ng staff ang iyong impormasyon; ito ay aaprubahan at ive-verify
Ibibigay sa iyo ang naka-print na ID
Ang mga aplikanteng kulang ang requirement ay tutulungan at papayuhan

qc.s-birth-ctc.name: Certified True Copy of Birth Certificate (QC-registered)

variants.time: 15 minutes if on database (1945–2015); 3 days if manual search
detail_steps: Submit filled-out request form and ID; receive order of payment
Pay at the City Treasurer’s cashier; receive claim stub
Receive the certified copy (Counter 5)
variants.note: For persons born in Quezon City; counters 1 & 2.
variants.note_tl: Para sa mga ipinanganak sa Quezon City; counters 1 at 2.
detail_steps_tl: Isumite ang napunang request form at ID; tanggapin ang order of payment
Magbayad sa cashier ng City Treasurer; tanggapin ang claim stub
Kunin ang certified copy (Counter 5)

detail_steps: Log in, click “Civil Registry Online Services”, then “Request for a Certificate”
Wait for the email saying the copy is ready for pick-up
Pick up at CCRD and pay at the City Treasurer’s Office
detail_steps_tl: Mag-log in, i-click ang “Civil Registry Online Services”, saka ang “Request for a Certificate”
Hintayin ang email na nagsasabing handa nang kunin ang kopya
Kunin sa CCRD at magbayad sa City Treasurer’s Office

qc.s-birth-registration.name: Registration of Certificate of Live Birth (within 30 days)
qc.s-birth-registration.exit_message: Registration after 30 days follows the delayed-registration process. Contact the City Civil Registry Department.

detail_steps: Submit the Certificate of Live Birth and all requirements at Counter 18
Receive the personal copy of the registered certificate
detail_steps_tl: Isumite ang Certificate of Live Birth at lahat ng requirement sa Counter 18
Tanggapin ang personal na kopya ng narehistrong certificate

variants.time: 1–3 days after submission, then submit originals
detail_steps: Log in, “Civil Registry Online Services”, then “Birth Registration”
Upload digital copies of the requirements
After the email notice, submit the original documents at CCRD
detail_steps_tl: Mag-log in, piliin ang “Civil Registry Online Services”, saka ang “Birth Registration”
I-upload ang digital na kopya ng mga requirement
Pagkatanggap ng email notice, isumite ang mga orihinal na dokumento sa CCRD

qc.s-birth-registration.exit_message_tl: Ang pagpaparehistro lampas sa 30 araw ay dumadaan sa delayed-registration na proseso. Makipag-ugnayan sa City Civil Registry Department.

variants.fee: As stated in the Business Tax Bill
detail_steps: Present the approved Computerized Business Tax Bill at the payment counter
Pay; receive the computerized business tax official receipt
variants.note: Online payment is also offered via QC E-Services (per the BPLD charter); details not captured here.
variants.note_tl: May online payment din sa QC E-Services (ayon sa BPLD charter); hindi nakuha rito ang mga detalye.
detail_steps_tl: Ipakita ang aprubadong Computerized Business Tax Bill sa payment counter
Magbayad; tanggapin ang computerized business tax official receipt

detail_steps: Pay business tax
File renewal via QC E-Services portal or kiosks: Business One-Stop Shop → Apply for Mayor’s Permit (Business) → Renewal
Input Mayor’s Permit number and current-year business tax OR; submit requirements
Claim the renewed permit or have it delivered
variants.note: Charter lists 30 minutes per evaluation stage but no single total; the system can auto-renew if compliant.
variants.note_tl: Nakalista sa charter ang 30 minuto bawat yugto ng evaluation pero walang kabuuang oras; maaaring mag-auto-renew ang sistema kung compliant ka.
detail_steps_tl: Bayaran ang business tax
Mag-file ng renewal sa QC E-Services portal o kiosk: Business One-Stop Shop → Apply for Mayor’s Permit (Business) → Renewal
Ilagay ang Mayor’s Permit number at ang OR ng business tax ngayong taon; isumite ang mga requirement
Kunin ang na-renew na permit o ipa-deliver ito

requires.label: Proof of birth date and address

detail_steps: Create a profile and account with QC E-Services
Select QC ID e-Application (or Request for Sectoral Status Change if you already hold a resident QC ID)
Wait for the approval email
Wait for the physical ID to be delivered
variants.note: Fee and processing time are not stated in the guide.
variants.note_tl: Hindi nakasaad sa guide ang bayad at tagal ng pagproseso.
detail_steps_tl: Gumawa ng profile at account sa QC E-Services
Piliin ang QC ID e-Application (o Request for Sectoral Status Change kung may resident QC ID ka na)
Hintayin ang approval email
Hintaying maihatid ang pisikal na ID

requires.label: Proof of birth date and address

detail_steps: Download or obtain the Senior Citizen QC ID Application Form from OSCA
Submit the accomplished form and all documents for OSCA verification
ID is sent to your home or can be picked up at OSCA
variants.note: Fee and processing time are not stated in the guide.
variants.note_tl: Hindi nakasaad sa guide ang bayad at tagal ng pagproseso.
detail_steps_tl: I-download o kunin sa OSCA ang Senior Citizen QC ID Application Form
Isumite ang napunang form at lahat ng dokumento para sa verification ng OSCA
Ipapadala ang ID sa iyong bahay o puwedeng kunin sa OSCA

variants.fee: Refer to the Schedule of Fees (computed by DBO)
detail_steps: Log in to QC E-Services → Building Permit One-Stop Shop; generate application forms and checklist
Add or select building professionals; print checklist and forms
Electronically submit for pre-evaluation and schedule an appointment
Drop off documents at the DBO kiosk on your appointment date
Claim the Order of Payment (bring valid ID) and pay at the City Treasurer’s cashier
Return the OR; permit released
variants.note: Payment window differs between sources: charter says Treasurer windows 13 or 14; the QCitizen guide says Counter 12. Confirm with DBO.
variants.note_tl: Magkaiba ang payment window sa mga source: windows 13 o 14 ng Treasurer ayon sa charter; Counter 12 ayon sa QCitizen guide. Kumpirmahin sa DBO.
detail_steps_tl: Mag-log in sa QC E-Services → Building Permit One-Stop Shop; gumawa ng application forms at checklist
Magdagdag o pumili ng mga building professional; i-print ang checklist at forms
I-submit online para sa pre-evaluation at magpa-schedule ng appointment
Ihatid ang mga dokumento sa DBO kiosk sa araw ng iyong appointment
Kunin ang Order of Payment (magdala ng valid ID) at magbayad sa cashier ng City Treasurer
Ibalik ang OR; ire-release ang permit

detail_steps: Visit https://payment.marikina.gov.ph
Click Sign Up and input account information (password needs an uppercase, lowercase, number and special character)
Verify your email using the message sent to you
variants.note: Fee and time are not stated in the sources read.
variants.note_tl: Hindi nakasaad sa mga nabasang source ang bayad at tagal.
detail_steps_tl: Pumunta sa https://payment.marikina.gov.ph
I-click ang Sign Up at ilagay ang impormasyon ng account (ang password ay dapat may malaking titik, maliit na titik, numero at special character)
I-verify ang iyong email gamit ang mensaheng ipinadala sa iyo

detail_steps: Fill in the PWD form and be interviewed by the PDAO focal person
Submit requirements, including pictures; staff review them and record them in the log book
PWD card is issued and your information is encoded in the database
Optional: request other assistance (burial, medical, assistive device, if available)
variants.note: Walk-in only in the sources read. The 2022 omnibus charter gives a different total (11 minutes and 10 seconds); the 2024 charter is used.
variants.note_tl: Walk-in lamang ayon sa mga nabasang source. Iba ang kabuuang oras sa 2022 omnibus charter (11 minuto at 10 segundo); ang 2024 charter ang ginamit.
detail_steps_tl: Punan ang PWD form at magpa-interview sa PDAO focal person
Isumite ang mga requirement, kasama ang mga litrato; susuriin ito ng staff at itatala sa log book
Ibibigay ang PWD card at ie-encode ang iyong impormasyon sa database
Opsyonal: humingi ng ibang tulong (burial, medical, assistive device, kung mayroon)

detail_steps: Submit the accomplished form with complete requirements; OSCA staff check them, interview you and encode your data
Claim the Senior Citizen’s ID and booklet
variants.note: For Marikina residents aged 60 or older. Walk-in only in the sources read.
variants.note_tl: Para sa mga residente ng Marikina na 60 taong gulang pataas. Walk-in lamang ayon sa mga nabasang source.
detail_steps_tl: Isumite ang napunang form kasama ang kumpletong requirement; susuriin ito ng OSCA staff, iinterbyuhin ka, at ie-encode ang iyong datos
Kunin ang Senior Citizen’s ID at booklet

mkn.s-birth-ctc.name: Certified True Copy of Birth Certificate (Marikina-registered)

detail_steps: Fill out the request form at LCRO Window 4 and submit it; the verifier checks availability in the database and issues the order of payment
Pay the CTC fee at the City Treasurer’s office and get the Official Receipt
Bring the OR to LCRO Window 4 to receive the certified copy
variants.note: Records registered at the Marikina City Civil Registry only. The same fee is shown for birth, marriage and death copies. Walk-in only in the sources read.
variants.note_tl: Para lamang sa mga rekord na nakarehistro sa Marikina City Civil Registry. Pareho ang bayad para sa kopya ng birth, marriage at death. Walk-in lamang ayon sa mga nabasang source.
detail_steps_tl: Punan ang request form sa LCRO Window 4 at isumite; titingnan ng verifier kung nasa database ito at magbibigay ng order of payment
Bayaran ang CTC fee sa City Treasurer’s office at kunin ang Official Receipt
Dalhin ang OR sa LCRO Window 4 para makuha ang certified copy

mkn.s-birth-registration.name: Registration of Certificate of Live Birth (on-time, within 30 days)
mkn.s-birth-registration.exit_message: Registration after 30 days follows the late-registration process. Contact the City Civil Registry Office (Window 5).

detail_steps: Submit the Certificate of Live Birth and requirements at LCRO; staff check completeness and give an order of payment
Pay the registration fee at the City Treasurer’s office
Bring the Official Receipt to LCRO Window 5 and get a claim stub with the release date
variants.note: For births in Marikina City. Walk-in only in the sources read.
variants.note_tl: Para sa mga ipinanganak sa Marikina City. Walk-in lamang ayon sa mga nabasang source.
detail_steps_tl: Isumite ang Certificate of Live Birth at mga requirement sa LCRO; titingnan ng staff kung kumpleto at magbibigay ng order of payment
Bayaran ang registration fee sa City Treasurer’s office
Dalhin ang Official Receipt sa LCRO Window 5 at kumuha ng claim stub na may petsa ng release

mkn.s-birth-registration.exit_message_tl: Ang pagpaparehistro lampas sa 30 araw ay dumadaan sa late-registration na proseso. Makipag-ugnayan sa City Civil Registry Office (Window 5).

variants.fee: Per the Revenue Code of Marikina City (computed by the portal)
detail_steps: Sign in at payment.marikina.gov.ph, select Business Permit & Licensing Office, enter your Business Account Number and click Renew
Input the actual/annual declared gross sales and attach your financial statement and quarterly VAT, then Submit
Select the business and quarter to pay, Compute Business Tax, Proceed to Checkout and pay (credit/debit card, GCash, Maya or Bayad App)
An email confirmation is sent after a successful payment
variants.note: Check your eBOSS compliance status first at https://bplo.marikina.gov.ph/client.
variants.note_tl: Tingnan muna ang iyong eBOSS compliance status sa https://bplo.marikina.gov.ph/client.
detail_steps_tl: Mag-sign in sa payment.marikina.gov.ph, piliin ang Business Permit & Licensing Office, ilagay ang iyong Business Account Number at i-click ang Renew
Ilagay ang aktwal/taunang idineklarang gross sales at i-attach ang financial statement at quarterly VAT, saka i-Submit
Piliin ang negosyo at quarter na babayaran, i-Compute ang Business Tax, Proceed to Checkout at magbayad (credit/debit card, GCash, Maya o Bayad App)
May ipapadalang email confirmation pagkatapos ng matagumpay na bayad

variants.fee: Per the Revenue Code of Marikina City (assessed by BPLO)
detail_steps: File the duly accomplished application form with complete requirements at BPLO (evaluation, assessment, billing and permit)
Pay at the Treasury Office cashier
Payment due dates for the current year: Jan 20, Apr 20, Jul 20, Oct 20 (1st to 4th quarter)
variants.note: The charter lists 15 minutes per stage (file, pay) with no single total.
variants.note_tl: Nakalista sa charter ang 15 minuto bawat yugto (pag-file, pagbayad) pero walang kabuuang oras.
detail_steps_tl: I-file ang napunang application form kasama ang kumpletong requirement sa BPLO (evaluation, assessment, billing at permit)
Magbayad sa cashier ng Treasury Office
Mga petsa ng bayad ngayong taon: Ene 20, Abr 20, Hul 20, Okt 20 (1st hanggang 4th quarter)

mkn.s-building-permit.name: Building permit and other ancillary permits (OBO)

variants.fee: Based on the Philippine Electrical Code, Mechanical Code and National Building Code
detail_steps: Submit complete requirements at the receiving section; the clerk checks the application
Two copies of the plan are endorsed to BFP
Technical evaluators check the electrical, sanitary, structural and architectural plans and property documents
The proposed construction is inspected
If compliant, the order of payment is prepared and approved; pay the permit fees at the cashier
The Building Official approves and the releasing clerk releases the permit
variants.note: Classified Highly Technical in the 2024 charter. Walk-in only in the sources read.
variants.note_tl: Nakaklasipika bilang Highly Technical sa 2024 charter. Walk-in lamang ayon sa mga nabasang source.
detail_steps_tl: Isumite ang kumpletong requirement sa receiving section; susuriin ng clerk ang aplikasyon
Dalawang kopya ng plano ang ie-endorse sa BFP
Susuriin ng mga technical evaluator ang electrical, sanitary, structural at architectural na plano at mga dokumento ng ari-arian
Iinspeksyunin ang balak na konstruksyon
Kung compliant, ihahanda at aaprubahan ang order of payment; bayaran ang permit fees sa cashier
Aaprubahan ng Building Official at ire-release ng releasing clerk ang permit
